# acecloud_lb_listener (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud Load Balancer Listener.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "acecloud_lb_listener" "http" {
  name            = "http-listener"
  protocol        = "HTTP"
  protocol_port   = 80
  loadbalancer_id = acecloud_load_balancer.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `loadbalancer_id` (String) ID of the load balancer this listener belongs to.
- `name` (String) Name of the listener. Changing this forces recreation.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for the listener. One of: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TCP`, `UDP`, `TERMINATED_HTTPS`.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port number for the listener (1-65535). Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) List of CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the listener. Empty list means no restriction.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent connections. Use `-1` for unlimited (default).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the listener.
- `insert_headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers to insert. Only applicable for HTTP/HTTPS/TERMINATED_HTTPS protocols. Common keys: `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Port`. Values are stringified booleans (`"true"`/`"false"`).
- `timeout_client_data` (Number) Frontend client inactivity timeout in milliseconds. Only applicable for TCP/UDP/PROXY protocols.
- `timeout_member_connect` (Number) Backend member connection timeout in milliseconds. Only applicable for TCP/UDP/PROXY protocols.
- `timeout_member_data` (Number) Backend member inactivity timeout in milliseconds. Only applicable for TCP/UDP/PROXY protocols.
- `tls_ciphers` (String) Colon-separated list of TLS ciphers (e.g. `ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384`). Only applicable for TERMINATED_HTTPS protocol.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was created.
- `default_pool_id` (String) ID of the default pool for this listener.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the listener.
- `operating_status` (String) Runtime health of the listener, independent of provisioning. Values: `ONLINE` (healthy), `OFFLINE` (administratively disabled or unreachable), `DEGRADED` (partially healthy), `DRAINING` (gracefully removing members), `NO_MONITOR` (no health monitor attached).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning state of the listener (create/update/delete lifecycle). Values: `PENDING_CREATE`, `ACTIVE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE`, `ERROR`. Terraform waits until this reaches `ACTIVE` before declaring the resource ready.
